# Best system integration specialists in Perth

If you need to connect ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP and Microsoft 365, I’d shortlist specialists based on their ability to integrate multiple vendors—not just implement one software platform.

The strongest candidates I found in Perth, Western Australia, fall into three groups: **multi-system integration consultancies, MYOB Acumatica specialists, and SAP enterprise integration partners.** No single provider’s published capabilities conclusively establish deep expertise in every system on your list, so it’s worth validating the exact integrations before choosing.

[www.365solutionsconsulting.com](https://www.365solutionsconsulting.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[brand.curtin.edu.au](https://brand.curtin.edu.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2018/08/Web-Providers.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Designing the integration architecture and coordinating multiple software vendors.

[Website](https://www.365solutionsconsulting.com/)

## Which provider fits your systems best?

| Your main requirement | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| All five platforms in one integration programme | Nano Solutions |
| CRM, middleware and automated data flows | CRM Online |
| Microsoft Dynamics, MYOB and business applications | Metisc |
| MYOB Acumatica implementation and integration | Kilimanjaro Consulting |
| Complex SAP integration | NTT DATA Business Solutions |
| Independent architecture and vendor coordination | 365 Solutions Consulting |


These are recommendations based on publicly described services, not a verified ranking of delivery quality. In particular, ask each provider to demonstrate a real integration involving your exact versions of SAP, MYOB Acumatica and Microsoft 365.

## Questions to ask before engaging a specialist

- **Connectors\:** Have you delivered integrations between our specific ERP, CRM, SAP and MYOB Acumatica versions?
- **Architecture\:** Would you use APIs, an integration platform such as Boomi, Azure Integration Services, or SAP BTP—and why?
- **Data ownership\:** Which system is authoritative for customers, products, inventory, invoices and payments?
- **Reliability\:** How do you handle failed synchronisations, duplicate records, API limits and audit trails?
- **Support\:** Who monitors integrations after launch, and what response times are included?
- **Evidence\:** Can you provide two relevant client references and a working example of a comparable integration?

My recommendation is to approach **Nano Solutions, CRM Online and Metisc first** for an integration-focused discussion, then include a dedicated Acumatica or SAP specialist wherever either system is the core of your architecture.

One important clarification: **which system is your main ERP today—MYOB Acumatica, SAP, or something else?** That will materially change which specialist I would put first.
